headline_requirement.statement: Confirming the opposing-direction compound sub-type at 80% power requires ~57 SSW events (vs 16 available); the present study is therefore powered to DESCRIBE the dissociation but not to CONFIRM irreducibility, which is why we present the sub-type as a hypothesis.
